title: Don't Throw Away the Tail: Action Upcycling for Policy Acceleration
abstract: arXiv:2609.34911v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Modern robot policies predict a chunk of future actions from a single observation, execute only a prefix, and discard the rest before replanning. Choosing the length of this prefix, the execution horizon, poses a trade-off between reactivity and efficiency. A short horizon keeps the policy reactive to the environment, but requires frequent policy calls. Recent test-time methods adaptively select the horizon for each chunk, but they either read model internals, where the signal must be chosen for each architecture, or draw extra samples, which adds cost. We propose Action Upcycling, a training-free algorithm that reuses actions the policy would otherwise discard, without accessing model internals or drawing extra samples. We find that discarded actions stay close to their replanned versions as long as the action velocity remains smooth. translated_title: 不要丢弃尾部：用于策略加速的动作升级再利用
translated_abstract: 现代机器人策略从单次观测预测一段未来动作，只执行其中的前缀部分，并在重新规划之前丢弃其余动作。选择这一前缀的长度（即执行时域）带来了反应性与效率之间的权衡：较短的时域能保持策略对环境的灵敏反应，但需要频繁调用策略。近期的测试时方法为每个动作块自适应地选择时域，但它们要么需要读取模型内部信息（信号必须针对每种架构单独设计），要么需要抽取额外样本（这会增加成本）。我们提出Action Upcycling（动作升级再利用），这是一种无需训练的算法，能够复用策略原本会丢弃的动作，而无需访问模型内部信息或抽取额外样本。我们发现，只要动作速度保持平滑，被丢弃的动作就会与其重新规划后的版本保持接近。因此，Action Upcycling将执行时域扩展到动作速度……
tldr: 提出无需训练的Action Upcycling算法，通过复用策略原本丢弃的尾部动作来延长执行时域，在不访问模型内部信息、不增加额外采样的前提下实现机器人策略加速。
en_tdlr: Action Upcycling is a training-free algorithm that accelerates robot policies by reusing the discarded tail actions to extend the execution horizon, without accessing model internals or drawing extra samples.
